findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True or unsanitized user input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/click-command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // subprocess.call/run/Popen with shell=True
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
  ) or
  (
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall()
  ) or
  (
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe command execution that could lead to command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with shell=True or unsanitized input

message.text: Potentially unsafe command execution that could lead to command injection.
Potentially unsafe command execution that could lead to command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Shell injection via shell completion
 * @description Shell completion code that constructs shell commands without proper escaping
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/click-shell-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  ) and
  call.getArg(0).asExpr().getLocation().getFile().getBaseName() = "shell_completion.py"
select call, "Potentially unsafe shell command execution in shell completion code."
findings.hypothesis: Shell completion code that constructs shell commands without proper escaping could lead to shell injection

message.text: Potentially unsafe shell command execution in shell completion code.
